ov: هوكوم (الإنجليزية: Hokum) هو فلم رعب قوطي خارق للطبيعة صدر عام 2026، وهو إنتاج دولي مشترك بين أيرلندا والإمارات العربية المتحدة. كتب الفلم وأخرجه داميان مكارثي، ويؤدي آدم سكوت بطولته ويشارك في أدوار مساندة كل من بيتر كونان وديفيد ويلموت وفلورنس أوردش ومايكل باتريك وويل أوكونيل وبريندان كونروي وأوستين أماليو. عُرض الفلم لأول مرة في مهرجان ساوث باي ساوث وست للسينما والتلفزيون 2026 في 14 مارس 2026، وصدر في الولايات المتحدة بواسطة نيون في 1 مايو 2026. ونال الفلم مراجعات إيجابية من النقاد، مع إشادة بالقصة والأداء وإخراج مكارثي.
plotEn:
Ohm Bauman is an American novelist struggling to finish his successful 'Conquistador' trilogy. After glimpsing the ghost of his mother, Ohm decides to visit The Bilberry Woods Hotel in rural Ireland, where his parents had honeymooned, to scatter their ashes. The hotel staff includes owner Cob, his son-in-law and front desk clerk Mal, groundskeeper Fergal, bartender Fiona, and bellhop Alby. Ohm overhears Cob tell two children the story of the Cailleach, a witch who takes children to the underworld in chains. Ohm is abrasive and dismissive toward the staff, but he warms to Fiona after she identifies the location of a photo his mother took. While spreading his parents' ashes, he meets Jerry, a local who lives in his van and frequently drinks milk laced with magic mushrooms.
Fiona and Alby tell Ohm that the honeymoon suite is locked and supposedly haunted by a witch. After belittling Alby's aspirations of a writing career, Ohm returns to his room. Later, Fiona finds Ohm's tape recorder at the bar. While attempting to return it, Fiona discovers that Ohm has hanged himself and saves him. Ohm awakens in a hospital and returns to the hotel weeks later. Mal informs him that Fiona has been missing since the hotel's Halloween party and that Jerry is suspected in both Fiona's disappearance and his wife's murder. Ohm confronts Jerry, who claims to have seen Fiona's ghost in the hotel, directing him to the honeymoon suite. Ohm doesn't believe Jerry, but agrees to check the suite with him.
